packet.headline_seed: Utah firefighter and four family members killed in flash flooding
packet.description_seed: A husband, wife and their three sons died - meaning that only a daughter who did not join the outing is still alive.

what: Utah firefighter and four family members killed in flash flooding

clean_source_blocks.text: Five members of a Utah family were killed in a flash flood over the weekend after going out for a day of hiking in the southern part of the US state, according to law enforcement officials. The victims included a fire captain, Spencer Long, his wife and three sons. A daughter who did not join the outing is the only member of the family not to have died. "It is believed the family fell victim to flooding caused by heavy rains," the Wayne County Sheriff's Office said in a statement, which did not name those who were killed. Identification of the family instead came from Provo Fire & Rescue, which announced the death of Captain Spencer Long in a statement of its own.

BICKNELL, Utah — A firefighter, his wife, and three of their children were killed by a flash flood in southern Utah on Friday. On Saturday, Provo Fire & Rescue announced the passing of Capt. Spencer Long and members of his family. The Wayne County Sheriff’s Office said five people were found dead after being caught up in flooding at a campground in Bicknell on Friday. While neither agency would confirm that these were the same two incidents, a GoFundMe connects the two incidents and says Long, his wife Katrina, and their three sons died in a flash flooding incident. It also says the couple had a daughter whose "life has forever been changed in an instant."
A husband, wife and their three sons died - meaning that only a daughter who did not join the outing is still alive.

"We are absolutely heartbroken by the death of Captain Spencer Long and his family," the fire department said. "Our thoughts are with his family, friends, and colleagues during this difficult time." A GoFundMe page appears to connect the sheriff's statement with the fire department and says that Long, his wife Katrina and their three sons - Reid, Thayne and Gage - died in a flash flood incident. The fundraising effort also says that the couple had a daughter whose "life has forever been changed in an instant". The family arrived at a campground near Bicknell, Utah, for a day trip on Friday, the sheriff's office said in its statement. Officials were called to that campground around 17:00 local time (23:00 GMT) on Friday, where a young male victim was found dead.

[Lähde: FOX 13 Utah | URL: https://www.fox13now.com/news/local-news/southern-utah/3-dead-following-flooding-at-sunglow-campground]
BICKNELL, Utah — A firefighter, his wife, and three of their children were killed by a flash flood in southern Utah on Friday.

On Saturday, Provo Fire & Rescue announced the passing of Capt. Spencer Long and members of his family.

The Wayne County Sheriff’s Office said five people were found dead after being caught up in flooding at a campground in Bicknell on Friday.

While neither agency would confirm that these were the same two incidents, a GoFundMe connects the two incidents and says Long, his wife Katrina, and their three sons died in a flash flooding incident. It also says the couple had a daughter whose "life has forever been changed in an instant."

In addition, Facebook posts from Mona City, where Katrina was a former council member, and Summit Medical Spa, of which Katrina was a co-founder, shared their sadness and condolences.

"Katrina dedicated countless hours of service to our community, and her kindness, leadership, and commitment made a lasting impact on so many lives. We will forever be grateful for all that Katrina and her family have done to support and strengthen our community," Mona City's post read. "Katrina's legacy of service and compassion will not be forgotten."

"[Katrina] was the heart of Summit Medical Spa," the business added. "She led with kindness, grace, and unwavering compassion, making every employee, client, and friend feel valued, supported, and truly appreciated... The Long family will forever remain in our hearts, and their legacy will live on through the lives they touched and the community they helped create."

"Today, we join our brothers and sisters at Provo Fire & Rescue in mourning the heartbreaking loss of one of their own," Pleasant Grove City Fire Department also wrote, along with several other local neighboring fire departments sharing their support. "Our thoughts and deepest condolences are with the firefighter’s family, friends, and every member of Provo Fire & Rescue during this incredibly difficult time."

Wayne County officials said deputies were called to the Sunglow Campground on Friday around 5 p.m. after a young male victim was found dead in a wash.

The search and rescue team later found evidence of the family having arrived in the area around 11:30 a.m. to go hiking and canyoneering.

During an ensuing search, two more victims, both male, were found dead. A search then continued for two missing individuals.

The sheriff's office later confirmed that they had found the two other family members,

payload.title: Palokapteeni ja neljä perheenjäsentä kuolivat äkkitulvassa Utahissa
payload.summary: Provon pelastuslaitoksen kapteeni Spencer Long, hänen vaimonsa Katrina ja heidän kolme poikaansa kuolivat päiväretkellä Etelä-Utahissa. Perheen tytär ei osallistunut retkelle.
payload.content:
Viisi saman perheen jäsentä kuoli äkkitulvassa Etelä-Utahissa Yhdysvalloissa perjantaina, kun perhe oli lähtenyt päiväretkelle Bicknellin lähellä sijaitsevalle leirintäalueelle. Kuolleet olivat Provon pelastuslaitoksen kapteeni Spencer Long, hänen vaimonsa Katrina sekä pariskunnan kolme poikaa Reid, Thayne ja Gage. Perheen tytär ei osallistunut retkelle ja jäi perheen ainoaksi eloon jääneeksi jäseneksi.

Perhe oli päiväretkellä Bicknellin lähellä

Waynen piirikunnan sheriffin toimiston mukaan perhe oli saapunut leirintäalueelle päivän mittaiselle retkelle. BBC:n mukaan tarkoituksena oli viettää päivä vaeltaen Utahin eteläosassa. Leirintäalue sijaitsee Bicknellin lähellä Waynen piirikunnassa. Sheriffin toimisto arvioi perheen joutuneen voimakkaiden sateiden aiheuttaman tulvan uhriksi. Tiedotteessa kuolleiden henkilöllisyyttä ei vielä kerrottu.

Viranomaiset saivat hälytyksen leirintäalueelle noin kello 17 paikallista aikaa eli kello 23 GMT-aikaa. Paikalta löydettiin ensin kuollut nuori mies. Sheriffin toimisto kertoi, että tulvan yhteydessä leirintäalueelta löydettiin kaikkiaan viisi kuollutta. Sen mukaan ihmiset olivat joutuneet perjantaina tulvan keskelle Bicknellissä.

Pelastuslaitos vahvisti Longin kuoleman

Provon pelastuslaitos ilmoitti lauantaina kapteeni Spencer Longin ja hänen perheenjäsentensä kuolemasta. Laitos kertoi olevansa Longin ja hänen perheensä kuolemasta täysin murtunut. ”Ajatuksemme ovat hänen perheensä, ystäviensä ja työtovereidensa luona tänä vaikeana aikana”, pelastuslaitos sanoi tiedotteessaan. Ilmoitus julkaistiin päivä sen jälkeen, kun sheriffin kuvaama tulva tapahtui. Longin henkilöllisyys tuli julki pelastuslaitoksen kautta, sillä sheriffin tiedotteessa uhreja ei nimetty.

Sheriffin toimisto ja pelastuslaitos eivät erikseen vahvistaneet, että niiden tiedotteet koskivat samaa tapausta. Perheen tueksi avattu GoFundMe-varainkeräyssivu kuitenkin yhdistää tapahtumat ja kertoo Spencer Longin, hänen vaimonsa Katrinan sekä poikien Reidin, Thaynen ja Gagen kuolleen äkkitulvassa. Pelastuslaitos nimesi Longin, mutta muut nimet tulivat julki varainkeräyksen yhteydessä. Myös paikallinen FOX 13 Utah raportoi yhteydestä varainkeräyssivun tietojen perusteella.

Varainkeräyssivun mukaan Longin ja Katrinan tytär ei lähtenyt mukaan päiväretkelle. Hän on siten perheen ainoa jäsen, joka ei kuollut tulvassa. Sivulla tyttären elämän sanotaan muuttuneen pysyvästi yhdessä hetkessä. Tapaus sattui perjantaina, ja Provon pelastuslaitos kertoi Longin sekä hänen perheensä kuolemasta seuraavana päivänä.
summary_bullets: Äkkitulva surmasi viisi saman perheen jäsentä Bicknellin lähellä Etelä-Utahissa.
Kuolleet olivat palokapteeni Spencer Long, hänen vaimonsa Katrina ja heidän kolme poikaansa.
Perheen tytär ei osallistunut päiväretkelle ja jäi perheen ainoaksi eloon jääneeksi jäseneksi.
payload.journalist_note: Sheriffin toimisto ja pelastuslaitos eivät vahvistaneet tiedotteidensa käsittelevän samaa tapahtumaa. Spencer Longin henkilöllisyys perustuu pelastuslaitoksen ilmoitukseen, kun taas Katrinan ja poikien nimet sekä viranomaistiedotteiden välinen yhteys perustuvat perheen varainkeräyssivuun.

Sivulla tyttären elämän sanotaan muuttuneen pysyvästi yhdessä hetkessä. Tapaus sattui perjantaina, ja Provon pelastuslaitos kertoi Longin sekä hänen perheensä kuolemasta seuraavana päivänä.
summary_bullets: Äkkitulva surmasi viisi saman perheen jäsentä Bicknellin lähellä Etelä-Utahissa.
Kuolleet olivat palokapteeni Spencer Long, hänen vaimonsa Katrina ja heidän kolme poikaansa.
Perheen tytär ei osallistunut päiväretkelle ja jäi perheen ainoaksi eloon jääneeksi jäseneksi.

article.source_text:
Five members of a Utah family were killed in a flash flood over the weekend after going out for a day of hiking in the southern part of the US state, according to law enforcement officials. The victims included a fire captain, Spencer Long, his wife and three sons. A daughter who did not join the outing is the only member of the family not to have died. "It is believed the family fell victim to flooding caused by heavy rains," the Wayne County Sheriff's Office said in a statement, which did not name those who were killed. Identification of the family instead came from Provo Fire & Rescue, which announced the death of Captain Spencer Long in a statement of its own.

BICKNELL, Utah — A firefighter, his wife, and three of their children were killed by a flash flood in southern Utah on Friday. On Saturday, Provo Fire & Rescue announced the passing of Capt. Spencer Long and members of his family. The Wayne County Sheriff’s Office said five people were found dead after being caught up in flooding at a campground in Bicknell on Friday. While neither agency would confirm that these were the same two incidents, a GoFundMe connects the two incidents and says Long, his wife Katrina, and their three sons died in a flash flooding incident. It also says the couple had a daughter whose "life has forever been changed in an instant."

A husband, wife and their three sons died - meaning that only a daughter who did not join the outing is still alive.

"We are absolutely heartbroken by the death of Captain Spencer Long and his family," the fire department said. "Our thoughts are with his family, friends, and colleagues during this difficult time." A GoFundMe page appears to connect the sheriff's statement with the fire department and says that Long, his wife Katrina and their three sons - Reid, Thayne and Gage - died in a flash flood incident. The fundraising effort also says that the couple had a daughter whose "life has forever been changed in an instant". The family arrived at a campground near Bicknell, Utah, for a day trip on Friday, the sheriff's office said in its statement. Officials were called to that campground around 17:00 local time (23:00 GMT) on Friday, where a young male victim was found dead.
